reported_metrics.transport_mean_rms: RMS across the frozen rings of the azimuthal m=0 cylindrical transport vector
reported_metrics.full_ring_transport_rms: unweighted RMS of the raw pressure/forcing-free transport over the frozen ring-angle samples
reported_metrics.transport_mean_to_full_rms_ratio: transport_mean_rms divided by full_ring_transport_rms with only a numerical tiny-value guard
reported_metrics.canonical_cr001_momentum_L2: volume-weighted spatial L2 of the complete momentum residual at each validation time

projection_boundary.jensen_forward_bound_supported: transport_mean_rms <= full_ring_transport_rms on the same sampled rings
projection_boundary.rule: A small or zero m=0 transport mean cannot by itself establish a small raw three-dimensional transport; m!=0 angular content can cancel under P0.

manufactured_nullspace_witness.scope: annulus r>0; mechanics-only projection witness, not repository candidate/source data
